# Stittsville Garage Doors
https://stittsvillegaragedoors.ca/

Sitemap: https://stittsvillegaragedoors.ca/sitemap-index.xml

Local garage door repair and installation in Stittsville, Ontario (west Ottawa). Same-day service, free on-site written quotes, transparent price ranges.

## Contact
- Phone: (613) 777-6401
- Email: stittsvillegd@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sun 7 AM – 10 PM; 24/7 emergency
- Service area: Stittsville, ON (Jackson Trails, Fairwinds, Crossing Bridge Estates, Amberwood Village, Wyldewood, Bryanston Gate)

## Services (typical CAD ranges, before tax)
- Spring repair: $250–$350 (double doors often $450–$550 for both springs)
- Cable repair: $150–$250
- Opener repair: $150–$300
- Track repair: $150–$250
- Panel repair (in-place only, no section swaps): $150–$400
- Maintenance tune-up: $150–$180
- New opener installed: $650–$950
- New insulated door installed: from $1,800
